text:
Avery: Hey team — last minute issue. I lost my physical insurance card and the specialist front desk is asking for proof of active coverage before they can check me in for a same-day referral. Is a screenshot of the insurer app sufficient or can People Ops generate a temporary coverage letter? Appointment in ~3 hours.

Priya (Benefits): Hi Avery — usually a screenshot of the insurer mobile app (showing policy number + your name) works at intake. That said, some clinics are strict and will ask for an official proof of coverage letter. We can generate a temporary proof PDF from our benefits portal and email it to the clinic. Typical turnaround is 30–60 minutes if you provide provider details.

Avery: Thank you! What exact info do you need from me so you can generate the letter quickly?

Priya (Benefits): Please send: employee full name, employee ID (or DOB), insurer/plan name, provider name and clinic address, appointment date & time, and if available the provider NPI or fax/email for medical records. Use this quick template to speed things up:

```
Subject: Urgent - temporary proof of coverage needed
Employee name: Avery Thompson
Employee ID: 012345
DOB: 1990-05-18
Plan: RedwoodCare Standard HMO
Appointment: 2024-06-05 14:30
Provider: Lakeside Specialty Clinic / Dr. Lin
Provider address: 402 Harbor Way, Suite 220
Provider NPI (if known): 1234567890
Notes: Same-day appointment, please email PDF to clinic and CC employee.
```

Jordan (People Ops): Quick tip — while Priya prepares the formal letter, take a screenshot of the insurer app page that shows your policy number and member name and present that at check-in. Many front desks accept that. If the clinic refuses, Priya can directly email the PDF to the clinic and request acceptance. I can also open the PeopleOps support ticket for you.

Avery: Uploading the app screenshot now and sending the template to benefits@redwood.com. Appointment confirmed for 14:30. Appreciate the fast help!

PeopleOpsBot: Created ticket PO-8421. Assigned to Priya (Benefits). Expedite flag set for same-day appointment. ETA for letter: 1 hour.

Priya (Benefits): Got the screenshot and template, Avery — generating the temporary proof letter now. I will DM you the PDF and email the clinic with the document and a brief confirmation. If the clinic requires an authorization or referral number, I will call the insurer right away and update the ticket.

Avery: Please email the clinic — they said emailed PDFs are acceptable. Thanks so much :pray:
